label: KIF5B::ALK

sections.text: KIF5B encodes a kinesin motor protein that transports cargo along microtubules.
ALK encodes a receptor tyrosine kinase involved in neural development.

The fusion retains the ALK kinase domain under an amino-terminal partner that promotes abnormal kinase activation. It is a rare driver in lung adenocarcinoma. A published lung-cancer case responded to crizotinib and later acquired ALK L1196M.
ALK-directed treatment is supported by the ALK-positive NSCLC indication; the cited evidence for this particular partner is a case report.
